text: Last thing, and it is the numbers. I am going to put a date on them out loud, because these age faster than anything else in this program.

As of August twenty twenty six. Claude Opus five gives you a million tokens. Gemini three pro, which is what Antigravity runs on, also gives you a million. And the smaller, cheaper models sit a long way below that. Claude Haiku four point five gives you two hundred thousand.

Those will be wrong soon and that is completely fine. What is worth carrying is the shape rather than the digits. The frontier models have all converged on a million. The gap that matters now is not the one between vendors. It is the one between the big models and the cheap ones.
